content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

Selling design assets online typically involves choosing a platform with various payment processing options. However, for creators in underserved regions, these options may not be available. This is where a sovereign digital commerce stack comes in. It allows you to host your products independently while utilizing tools like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare for hosting and NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This architecture not only avoids high platform fees—like the 10% charged by Gumroad—but also grants you full ownership of your digital storefront and customer data, ensuring your business runs smoothly without reliance on third-party providers.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, a sovereign commerce stack consists of integrated components that work together seamlessly. You can host your digital assets on platforms like GitHub Pages, which is free, while using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic to automate delivery. When a customer purchases your design asset, NOWPayments processes the transaction in real-time, converting the crypto payment to USD at the moment of sale. This architecture ensures that you can sell design assets quickly and efficiently, without the delays often associated with traditional payment processors. With low fees—just 0.5% for NOWPayments—you keep more of your hard-earned revenue.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed specifically for digital creators in countries where conventional payment processors are either unavailable or restrictive. If you sell ebooks, courses, or design assets like presets and plugins, this architecture is tailored for you. It empowers you to accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, eliminating the hassles of traditional banking systems. By adopting this stack, you are not just selling products; you are building a resilient business model that is independent of fluctuating currencies and unstable financial systems.
Keep 99.5% of your revenue with low fees from NOWPayments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

To effectively sell your design assets, you need a combination of tools that function well together. The Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack from COREMERCH provides everything necessary for a fully operational online store. With the Starter Stack, you can deploy your site in 48 hours, easily load products, and handle payments through NOWPayments. The Edge Commerce Stack further enhances your setup with Supabase for order management and automated email configurations for customer engagement. Each component is designed to be free or low-cost, ensuring that you maintain full control over your business and its profitability.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by selecting the COREMERCH stack that fits your needs, whether the Sovereign Starter Stack or the Edge Commerce Stack. Set up your hosting through GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages and configure your backend logic using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Next, integrate NOWPayments for processing crypto transactions, ensuring you can accept payments in the cryptocurrencies of your choice. Finally, upload your design assets and test the purchase flow to ensure that everything functions correctly. This straightforward approach allows you to launch your digital storefront quickly and effectively.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can use a sovereign commerce stack, which allows for direct crypto payments with low fees. By leveraging tools like GitHub Pages for hosting, along with NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, you can effectively manage your digital sales without relying on traditional payment platforms.
Automate your digital asset delivery with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you are looking for a comprehensive solution to build your digital store, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all six blueprints and seven templates you need. This kit enables you to deploy and scale efficiently. Explore more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

NOWPayments offers numerous advantages, including low transaction fees of 0.5%, support for over 300 cryptocurrencies, and the ability to process payments without requiring customer accounts.
